bull.b: Strong current growth and higher full-year guidance indicate continued customer adoption and market expansion. A roughly 24% FY2026 growth outlook provides a durable foundation for scaling revenue over the next several quarters.

Larger customers, multiproduct adoption and AI product usage strengthen Klaviyo’s competitive position and raise switching costs. Better retention among multiproduct customers also supports expansion revenue and a more durable customer base.

Robust free cash flow and modest leverage give Klaviyo flexibility to fund product development, acquisitions and international expansion without relying heavily on external capital. This improves resilience while the company builds consistent GAAP profitability.

bear.b: Despite strong revenue and cash flow, GAAP earnings remain minimal, leaving results vulnerable to expense growth or slower demand. The limited earnings cushion means Klaviyo has not yet fully demonstrated durable operating leverage at scale.

bear.t: Gross Margin and Operating Income Pressure
bear.b: Text messaging mix, higher carrier fees, acquisition costs and continued product investment are constraining profitability. If these pressures persist, revenue growth may translate less efficiently into operating income and cash earnings.

A temporary but extended NRR headwind can slow expansion within the installed base and increase reliance on new customer acquisition. Lower net retention would make growth more dependent on sales execution and sustained demand.
